item.tib: gtso mchog dgra chos yang dag mthar thug gi 'grigs yig ltas chog shel dkar me long
item.coloph: ces gtso mchog dgra chos yang dag mthar thug gi 'grigs (yig) ltas chog g.ya' bral shel dkar me long 'di yang / rang 'dri'i gong ma'i skyes chen mkhas pa'i dbang por son pa rnams kyi spyan lam du 'bab pa'i mchod sprin du mi 'gyur mod na'ang/ bon sgo spyi dang bye brag phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang sogs tha na srung zlog bsad pa'i las tshogs tsam yang gzhung lugs dgongs don gang gi khung (khungs) mi chod kyang rtsol ba zhan pa'i blo chung ba khung (khong) dge rnams la/ phan sems kyis rnga sprang ma ti d+hA dzas ri sul zhig la thun mtshams su bris pas dge des bstan 'gro bde skyid kyi dpal la spyod pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig gi smon pa dang bcas zla tshes la dge'o//
